# Set Player Variable At Index

Source: [4429](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4429); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Set Player Variable At Index](../../api/actions/set-player-variable-at-index.md).

<a id="wiki-4429-n1"></a>

- A non-array player variable is replaced by an empty array before the indexed write; writing beyond the end extends with zero-valued elements.

<a id="wiki-4429-n2"></a>

- Supplying multiple players modifies each player's variable.
